tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed las/ sgrub pa'i skabs kyi cho ga ye shes rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi bsnyen pa las rung sngon du song nas/ sgrub pa ni/ thog mar bris sku'i cho ga gnas dben par mtshams bsdams te/ lha bzo ba gso sbyong dang ldan pas/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u las ras bris bdun bshad pa'i bdun pa nyid yin pas/ rgyal phur 'dzoms pa sogs gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la/ ras skra med pa kha tshar ma nyams pa la spyin sogs mi gtsang ba ma 'dres pa zang khu la sogs pas ras 'dul legs par byas la/ tshon ma 'dres par mtha' rtsi shing rgyas pa'i ri bos bskor ba/ 'og tu bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho/ me tog dang / ngang ngur la sogs pa'i chu byas brgyan pa'i 'gram ne'u sing la glang po che sna tshogs gnas pa/ mtsho'i dbus na pad sdong gi rtse mor sna tshogs pad+ma ches yangs pa'i lte ba ljang zhing mtho ba'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'jam dpal ston zla ltar dkar ba/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas ut+pa la'i steng du pu ti bzhag pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho rgyas pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ bla gos phrag par gzar ba/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bri/ pad sdong gi yal ga las thon pa'i g.yas g.yon du pad+ma dkar po zla ba dang bcas pa gnyis kyi steng du g.yas su kun tu bzang po spri yang ku ltar sngo ba/ g.yas rnga yab dkar po g.yob cing / g.yon rin po che bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rnga yab gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ gnyis ka zhal 'jam dpal la lta ba/ 'jam dpal las chung ba/ na bza' sngon po gsol ba/ rin po che cod paṇa dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

mu tig dang / rin po che'i mchod phyir thogs byas pa bri/ steng du lha'i bu gnyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sprin sbubs las byung ba bri/ 'og tu rdo leb la sgrub pa po dbyibs cha lugs ji lta ba spos phor thogs pa/ gtso bo'i phyag mchog sbyin gyi 'og tu bcom ldan 'das la blta ba bri/ nyi ma gcig la rab gnas dang bcas pa grub na legs/ ༈ de nas sgrub pa dngos ni/ yod na sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten yang bshams/ de lta bu'i bris sku de shar phyogs su bkram/ de'i mdun du ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal ri gling rnams kyi tshom bu so bdun ma bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa lnga/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma gcig rnams rgya che bar bshams/ bgegs bskrad gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang bar bshad pas/ cha gsum yid ches nges shes pa btang bas 'thus/ gnas khang rten mchod rnams gu gul gyis bdug rang gos gsar pa gyon cing / byung na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blangs shing / de ma grub na'ang dkar gsum la sogs pa bza'/ rten la kha phyogs par 'dug rnam pa kun tu khrus dang gtsang sbra gal che/ grib la 'dzem/ rang bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa dang mthar mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar sngar gyi bsnyen pa bzhin bya/ 'dir mchod pa byin rlabs bya rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar dharma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar byas la bzhag de nas rten ras bris bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rtsi shing rgyas pa'i ri bos bskor ba zhes sogs nas steng du lha'i bu gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sprin sbubs nas byung ba/ zhes pa'i bar bris sku'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bris zhes pa'i tshig rnams dor nas ngag tu brjod cing bsam/ de ltar rten de rje btsun dngos su bsgoms te/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer byung ba bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas 'khor lo 'khor te mi shes pa'i mun pa sangs/

shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par bsam la thun bzhir bsgom bzlas la brtson par bya/ thun mtshams rnams su mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de'ang maṇ+ḍal gyi gsol btab/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi lha tshogs la bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi mi shes pa'i mun pa sangs shing / shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ shes shing nus na gang gi mchod rdzas ma'ang sbyar/ bstod pa'i skabs su paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i don zab sngags kyi stobs kyi sogs byung na shin tu legs/ gtor ma chab kyis bran/ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs oṃ waka kye daṃ na ma/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ sna ma'i me tog la sngags nas 'bul bar gsungs kyang bod 'dir dngos mi 'byor bas/ dzā ti'i phye ma dang me tog dkar po sbags pa sngags re dang bstun nas stong phrag gcig 'jam dpal gyi zhal la gtor/ 'dod pa'i don la rtse gcig tu gsol btab la/ mjug tu bsdo ba smon lam bkris bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas bris sku las hūm̐ gi sgra'am/ ras bris 'gul ba 'byung ste/ hūm̐ gi sgras ni sa kun la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur la/ ras bris 'gul na rgol ba thams cad la lan 'debs nus pa/ 'jig rten gyi bstan bcos shes par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma de gnyis ma byung kyang las thams cad la nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud las zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dbyangs can gyi ngag thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrubs pas dngos dang rmi lam gyi rtags rnams yang yang 'byung zhing brtan par 'byung / gal te ma byung na bskyar thang gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ ji ltar sgrib pa che zhing bul na'ang lan bdun tshun la rtags gnyis mi 'byung mi srid/ spogs chog dang bcas pa'o/ /rtags bzang ngan gang byung yang mi la mi bshad par gsang ba dang /

ched 'dzin med par mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i sngags kyi kha skong gi sbyin sreg kyang bya'o/ /zhes pa 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi tshos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed ces bya ba las bris sku sgrub pa spogs chog dang bcas pa 'di ni/ mi dbang rdo rje 'dzin pa sa skyong bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bskul zhing thugs dam du bstar ba'i ched du gab 'khrugs man ngag tu yod pa rnams ma sbas par bklag chog tu chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa shes rab lhun grub kyis bgyis pa'o/ /shu bha mastu sarba dza gat+taṃ/ bkra shis/ maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ sgrub pa'i skabs kyi cho ga ye shes rab rgyas/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
